snippets.snippet_text: "This is HUGE. Etsy is home to thousands, maybe tens of thousands, of supply sellers offering blanks like tumblers, shirts, and hats. Many of those may now be considered noncompliant."

"I did the hard work and I take all of my own photos, make all of my own mockups, and all of my other designs. I also make all of my own products that I put my designs on, and I do it myself within my own business. Everyone should have to do the same on Etsy. It's about time that Etsy changed the rules to protect real artists."

possible_subjects: Etsy: creativity standards update may classify thousands of supply sellers (blanks: tumblers, shirts, hats) as noncompliant
Etsy seller: supports creativity standards update to protect original-content artists from generic or AI-generated competition
